title: Morphics Body Type (a node in the tree: top category > subcategory > size)

id.description: A child id is its parent's id plus one more segment. Top categories are base.walker, base.swimmer, base.flyer.

parent.description: Parent base id. Absent on a top category.

skeleton.description: Unreal asset path. Set on a subcategory only. Sizes inherit it.

required_animations.description: Set on a subcategory only. Sizes inherit it.

proportion_notes.description: Optional. How this size differs from its subcategory.

animation_overrides.description: Animations this size replaces. Every other animation is inherited from its subcategory. Names must be in the subcategory's required_animations.

spectrum.description: Spectrum id (a color in data/spectrums.json). Set on a subcategory only. Sizes inherit it. Several subcategories may share one color.

rig.description: Rig id. Set on a subcategory only. Sizes inherit it. It is the skeleton contract for retargeting.

mesh.description: Base mesh id. Set on a subcategory only. Skins attach to this mesh.

gait.description: The gait set of this subcategory. Set on a subcategory only.
